description: Biz uzay araştırmalarına meraklı 3 kişilik bir ekibiz. Projemizde Dünya'daki zorlu coğrafyaları (çöl, kutup, volkanik alanlar) inceleyerek Ay ve Mars'a en uygun analog ortamları haritalandırıyoruz. Haritalama, jeoloji ve veri görselleştirmeyle ilgilenen arkadaşları bekleriz!
summary: In this project, we used Lake Meke Crater in Karapınar, Konya as a Mars analog on Earth to develop a great testing and simulation environment for future space and Mars missions. In our project, we built a comprehensive system aimed at testing the wheel mobility and autonomous navigation of exploration rovers on rough terrains, examining the dust protection performance of astronaut suits, designing Mars habitats inspired by Meke's crater structure, and trying out soil and rock sample collection systems. In this way, by avoiding the multi-billion-dollar cost burden of testing in space, we gained the opportunity to pre-develop and test our robots, suits, and living space designs on Earth thanks to the 85% similarity ratio offered by Meke.
details: In our "Mars on Our Planet" project, we positioned Lake Meke Crater—located in Karapınar, Konya, and formed by the interaction of magma and groundwater—as a critical terrestrial analog for future space and Mars missions. Offering an 85% similarity ratio in scenarios where classic analogs fall short, this volcanic site allowed us to simulate rover mobility and autonomous navigation, the dust protection performance of astronaut suits, crater-inspired Mars habitats, and sample collection systems. This study aims to eliminate the multi-billion-dollar cost burden of testing in space, enhance the independent exploration capabilities of robots, and develop more durable designs for future habitats to be established on Mars.
